variables.name: Surface air temperature
variables.about: Average temperature of the air near the ground. Rising values suggest warming.

variables.name: Precipitation
variables.about: Rain and snow reaching the ground. Trends can be wetter in one place and drier in another.

variables.name: Aerosol optical depth
variables.about: How much sunlight is blocked by haze, smoke and dust in the air. Higher = more particles.

variables.name: Vegetation greenness (NDVI)
variables.about: How green and healthy plants look from space. Rising = greening, falling = browning.

variables.name: Sea surface temperature
variables.about: Temperature of the top layer of the ocean. Drives weather, storms and marine ecosystems.

method.trend: Seasonal cycle removed; slope = least-squares rate per year; significance = Mann-Kendall test.
method.combined: Each variable's |Mann-Kendall Z| is converted to a percentile rank (0-1) so units don't matter; the combined score is the mean over variables with data in that cell (>= 2 required).
